svg.text: Proof: Each Swap Shortens the Cycle by One
induction on the cycle length k · then: nothing outside moves · then: the hypotheses that carry the load
Claim · for the top's cycle (t d₁ … dₖ₋₁) of dest, the loop while dest[t] ≠ t: swap(t, dest[t])
finishes in exactly k − 1 swaps, leaves every cycle member fixed, and modifies nothing outside the cycle.
a (k−1)-cycle through t — the induction hypothesis applies

g.text: dest′[d₁] = dest[t] = d₁ → d₁ fixed · dest′[t] = dest[d₁] = d₂ → (t d₂ … dₖ₋₁)
all other entries untouched · IH: k−2 more swaps in the smaller cycle ⇒ 1 + (k−2) = k−1 ∎

svg.text: termination: |cycle of t| drops by exactly 1 per swap — k → k−1 → ⋯ → 1; a strictly decreasing natural number cannot fall forever
Nothing outside the cycle ever moves

g.text: 1 · a swap modifies only the two entries it exchanges — by definition, nothing else
2 · every swap the loop performs is (t, dest[t]): t ∈ C, and by the induction the successive targets d₁, d₂, … are exactly the members of C
3 · so no position outside C is ever an endpoint of any swap ⇒ entries and slots outside C are bit-identical when the loop ends ∎

svg.text: The load-bearing hypotheses — what breaks without them
1 · the partner must be dest[t], not the pre-image
loop exits (top is home) — (0 1) stranded topless

g.text: swapping with the pre-image also “makes progress” — the top is
homed immediately. But the split severs the top instead of a fixed
point: the remainder is a topless cycle, and the loop condition
dest[t] = t is already true — it halts, unfinished.
the induction's key line — “the remainder is a (k−1)-cycle
still through t” — is only true for the dest[t] choice.
in the case table of the optimality page this is the strand row: ΔΦ = +1

svg.text: 2 · dest must be destination-ward, not source-ward

g.text: the inverse array f = dest⁻¹ (“fetch position i's slot
from f(i)”, Duijvestijn's convention) is also a valid
permutation — and on 2-cycles the two coincide,
so simple tests pass either way.
run the destination-ward loop on source-ward data
and every partner is the pre-image: hypothesis 1's
strand bug, on every cycle of length ≥ 3.

svg.text: 3 · the stack and the mapping must swap in lockstep
dest[t] now describes a slot that is no longer there —
the proof's equations stop describing the machine
not load-bearing, but model boundaries: equal values (retagging can beat k−1 at the value level) and SWAP reach (the swap may be illegal — Blocked)
change what “optimal” means, not whether the cycle resolves · Shuffler.cpp · Emission::permute
